newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fell 3.7 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fell 3.7 pct in February.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, fell a year-on-year 3.7 percent in February after a 0.7 percent dip in January and a rise of 3.8 percent in February 1996, the Federal Statistics Office said.
The office said February had one shopping day less than the same month last year, accounting for a decline of 0.3 percent.

Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in February was 4.5 percent lower than a year ago, with sales of foods down 4.9 percent, clothes and textiles down 0.9 percent and all other sectors combined down 5.2 percent.
